hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Clean card UI and deliberate Tableau10 palette show design intent, but the circle pack renders cropped in viewport and the dense dark edge bundles overwhelm the pastel fills without enough visual hierarchy between data and chrome.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Structurally honest: scaleSqrt used correctly for force-layout radius encoding and sunburst radial scaling, data-driven domains via d3.extent/root.count(), and key functions present on both node and link data joins — no bar/area baseline violations apply to this topology layout.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Easing param sliders call full updateLayout() on every input event un-throttled; force layout launches a tick simulation concurrent with an in-flight shape-morph transition causing dual position writes; shared animationFrameId/frameCount vars across rapid updateLayout() calls let one transition's interrupt handler cancel the RAF owned by a later transition.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: The colored circle-pack hierarchy is readable with up to 10 Tableau10 hues, but 300 low-tension (8%) edge bundles drawn simultaneously at full opacity collapse into an opaque dark tangle through the center, overwhelming the structure they're meant to reveal — interaction (click-to-highlight, fade-others) is the only escape hatch, and it can't be assessed from a static screenshot.
